items.summary: Update the Facebook social link so it navigates to a valid Facebook URL instead of the current placeholder, by changing the `FACEBOOK_URL` constant in `frontend/src/content/socialLinks.ts`.

Harden the footer social icon links in `frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx` so placeholder URLs (e.g., '#', empty string) do not appear as 'broken links' to users: when a social URL is not a valid external URL, disable the icon interaction (no navigation) and apply a disabled visual state; when valid, open the link in a new tab with `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"` (apply consistently to Facebook and X/Twitter).
